name: DEE Development Engineers Limited
summary: DEE Development Engineers Limited manufactures and sells prefabricated engineering products, pipe fittings, and piping systems in India and internationally. It operates in three segments: Piping, Power, and Heavy Fabrication. The company offers pressure piping systems, piping spools, induction pipe bends, longitudinally submerged arc welding pipes, industrial pipe fittings, pressure vessels, industrial stacks, and modular skids, as well as boiler superheater coils, de-super heaters, and other customized manufactured components.
